scope: post hoc exploratory stratification; Referee 1 point 5
site_rule: reported individually at 10 participants or more, pooled below that; the floor was fixed before the counts were read
caution: a stratum AUC rests on that stratum's pCR participants alone, so the smallest strata are not informative about the substitution; no stratum difference is claimed, and no threshold for one was prespecified. The retained-fraction analysis beside it uses every examination and no outcome.
